abilities.name: Image Transmission
abilities.description: Activate to switch places with a target Mirror Image, removing most negative effects from Samuro and the Mirror Image. Advancing Strikes Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase Samuro's Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds.

fields.notes: Advancing Strikes and the talents enhancing it proc independently on Samuro and each of his Mirror Images.

abilities.name: Mirror Image
abilities.description: Teleport a short distance in the direction of the mouse cursor, creating 2 images for 8 seconds with 100% of Samuro's current Health that Basic Attack enemies for 11 damage. Images have their duration increased by 1 second each time they or Samuro use a Basic Attack against an enemy Hero. Whenever an Image takes damage, it deals that amount of damage to itself, effectively doubling the damage it takes. Maximum 2 Mirror images can be active at a time. Using Mirror Image removes most negative effects from Samuro. Mirror Image

fields.notes: Samuro appears in the direction of the player's mouse cursor when Mirror Image is cast. Samuro and his Mirror Images spawn in an equilateral triangle around the point where the ability was cast from. Using Mirror Image puts Samuro in Stasis for 0.125 seconds, removing most debuffs from Samuro and making him briefly untargetable and immune to damage. Usable while Rooted as it is cleansed by the Stasis. Samuro and the Images retain the last attack command given to Samuro before casting the Ability and attempt to complete it when the cast ends, unless they are spawned within Basic Attack range of another target, in which case they will focus that target instead. Mirror Images deal the same type of damage that Samuro does. Mirror Images gain all benefits from Samuro's Trait and Talents affecting it. Mirror Images can be affected by Regeneration Globes' healing, but cannot pick them up themselves. The effect is not shared between Samuro and his Images. Killing Mirror Images rewards no XP or Takedown credit.

abilities.name: Critical Strike
abilities.description: Samuro's next Basic Attack within 8 seconds will be a Critical Strike, dealing 50% increased damage. This also applies to Images, and does not break Wind Walk. Passive Samuro and his Images deal a Critical Strike on every 4th Basic Attack.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself. Activating sets Samuro's next attack to be a critical strike (regardless of if it already was), putting the Ability on cooldown. Activating resets Samuro's Basic Attack cooldown, causing his next Basic Attack to strike immediately. Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Samuro's Basic Attack damage.

abilities.name: Wind Walk
abilities.description: Grant Samuro Stealth for up to 10 seconds or until he attacks, uses an Ability, or takes damage. While Stealthed, Samuro heals for 2% of his maximum Health per second, his Movement Speed is increased by 20%, and he can pass through other units. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible. Samuro is Unrevealable for the first 1 second of Wind Walk.

fields.notes: Using Mirror Image and Mounting during the Unrevealable period will break Stealth once the Unreveable ends.

abilities.name: Bladestorm
abilities.description: Cause a Bladestorm of destructive force around Samuro for 3 seconds, granting him 25 Armor and dealing 180 damage per second to nearby enemies.; 30 / 0.5; Heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Armor, Mobile channel
fields.notes: Bladestorm can be ended prematurely by reactivating the Ability. All other Abilities are disabled during Bladestorm, and Bladestorm is also disabled during the brief Stasis window of Mirror Image and Image Transmission. This also prevents them from being successively cast using the Command Queue system (hold Shift by default). Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Illusion Master
abilities.description: Mirror Images can be controlled individually or as a group and their damage is increased by 100%. Passive Image Transmission's cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.; 8; Heroic

fields.notes: Illusion bonus damage stacks additively with other damage modifiers. Illusion Master 's active shares a cooldown with Image Transmission, and has all the same properties. Mirror Images have a copy of Illusion Master active and Image Transmission, both of which swap the Image using it with Samuro. The cooldown is shared between Samuro and all his Images. Mirror Images can Mount, Hearth and drink from Healing Fountains. The effect and cooldowns are independent from Samuro and his other Images, including those that have expired. Images can fake capturing Objectives. A Mirror Image Hearthing does not destroy any Mirror Images, but real Samuro Hearthing still does. The Command Queue system can be used to queue Mirror Image and then Illusion Master to swap places with a targeted Mirror Image and then create a new set at his location prior to the swap.

talents.name: Way of Illusion
talents.description: quest Every time a Mirror Image Critically Strikes a Hero, Samuro gains 0.25 Basic Attack damage, up to 10. After hitting 40 Heroes, Samuro gains an additional 30 Basic Attack damage.
_raw_fields: quest Every time a Mirror Image Critically Strikes a Hero, Samuro gains 0.25 Basic Attack damage, up to 10. After hitting 40 Heroes, Samuro gains an additional 30 Basic Attack damage.

talents.description: Critical Strike now happens for Samuro and his Mirror Images every 3rd Basic Attack. Samuro and his Mirror Images' Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes reduce their Physical Armor by 5 for 2.25 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with itself, but not with other negative Physical Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Critical Strike now happens for Samuro and his Mirror Images every 3rd Basic Attack. Samuro and his Mirror Images' Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes reduce their Physical Armor by 5 for 2.25 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

fields.notes: Does not stack with Wind Walk 's baseline Movement Speed bonus nor other sources of Movement Speed.

fields.notes: Stacks are not removed by Spell Damage from Heroic Summons, although their damage is reduced. Does not stack with itself or other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.name: Burning Blade
talents.description: Critical Strikes from Samuro and Mirror Images deal an additional 50% of their Basic Attack damage as Spell Damage to the target and nearby enemies.

fields.notes: Samuro's Burning Blade attacks deal 51 damage around the target and his Images' attacks 5.5 damage. Samuro's Burning Blade attacks benefit from 50% of flat damage bonuses from Way of Illusion. Burning Blade damage is unaffected by Basic Attack damage modifiers, like Critical Strike or Illusion Master's Image bonus damage, but can be affected by offensive damage modifiers that affect Samuro's Spell Damage output. Burning Blade 's damage reduction to Samuro himself stacks multiplicatively and damage reduction to Images stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Samuro's Spell Damage output.

_raw_fields: Critical Strikes from Samuro and Mirror Images deal an additional 50% of their Basic Attack damage as Spell Damage to the target and nearby enemies.

Basic Attack damage buff is incremented just before each Basic Attack connects, and hence each Basic Attack itself benefits from the increased damage. Stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Samuro's Basic Attack damage.
